# Security Checklist: Guest MAC Resolution Behind the OLT Relay

**Purpose**: Test the quality of the requirements for access (MAC binding, grants, admin bypass), privacy (MAC and IP in logs) and payment attribution
**Created**: 2026-10-06
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `checklist` procedure based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Access: MAC Binding, Grants, Admin Bypass

- [ ] CHK001 Is "relay MAC" defined with one objective rule that needs no config list? [Clarity, Spec §FR-006]
- [ ] CHK002 Are all MAC sources that feed login binding and time grants listed for the guard? [Completeness, Spec §FR-009, §FR-008]
- [ ] CHK003 Is the admin-device bypass named as covered by the same guard? [Coverage, Spec §FR-007, §FR-013]
- [ ] CHK004 Is the behavior after a rejected relay MAC specified (which fallbacks, in which order)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-010]
- [ ] CHK005 Is it specified that a relay MAC is never saved to any cookie or the account? [Completeness, Spec §FR-011]
- [ ] CHK006 Is the handling of already-saved relay MACs specified, including the known account row? [Coverage, Spec §FR-012]
- [ ] CHK007 Do the requirements keep the rule that `?mac=` is client-influenceable and a fallback MAC is not a verified binding? [Consistency, Spec §Assumptions, Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK008 Is the behavior defined when the relay MAC list cannot be read from the router (fail open or fail closed)? [Edge Case, Spec §FR-015]
- [ ] CHK009 Is it specified that two guests behind the same relay never share one MAC? [Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK010 Is the high-risk rule (failing test first, then fix, then live evidence) stated for every access path touched? [Completeness, Spec §FR-017]

## Privacy: MAC and IP in Logs

- [ ] CHK011 Is the masking format for the MAC in the diagnostic line specified? [Clarity, Spec §FR-002]
- [ ] CHK012 Is the reason the full client IP is allowed stated, with its limit (staged VM, no real users)? [Assumption, Spec §FR-003]
- [ ] CHK013 Is the end of the temporary full-IP log defined with a clear trigger and outcome? [Completeness, Spec §FR-016, §SC-005]
- [ ] CHK014 Is it specified that the full-IP log must not reach a deploy that has real users? [Completeness, Spec §FR-016a]
- [ ] CHK015 Is the "no source matched" log line covered by the same masking rules? [Consistency, Spec §FR-004]

## Payments Attribution

- [ ] CHK016 Is the expected payment record content (circuit ID and access point name) stated for the live test? [Measurability, Spec §SC-004]
- [ ] CHK017 Is the dependency on the GH #97 checkout fix (PR #115) documented? [Dependency, Spec §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK018 Is the attribution outcome specified when no valid guest MAC is found after rejection (bridge fallback stays)? [Edge Case, Spec §FR-016b]
- [ ] CHK019 Do the requirements state that credit and payment confirmation rules are unchanged by this feature? [Consistency, Spec §FR-016c]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [ ] CHK020 Is the live test size defined (number of dashboard and checkout loads)? [Measurability, Spec §SC-003]
- [ ] CHK021 Is the unit-test coverage tied to a counted list of sources? [Measurability, Spec §SC-002]
- [ ] CHK022 Is Story 2's source fix marked as dependent on Story 1, with a clear point where the user confirms it? [Dependency, Spec §FR-014]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by the `specify` procedure and the `clarify` procedure
- `st-build` reads checklist state but does not modify markers
